name: automattic/wpcom-legacy-redirector
description: WordPress plugin for handling large volumes of legacy redirects in a scalable manner.

prepare-ci: bash bin/install-wp-tests.sh wordpress_test root root localhost

scripts-descriptions.cs-fix: Run PHP Code Sniffer and fix violations
scripts-descriptions.i18n: Generate a POT file for translation
scripts-descriptions.lint-ci: Run PHP linting and send results to stdout
scripts-descriptions.prepare-ci: Prepare the environment for integration tests
scripts-descriptions.prepare-behat-tests: Prepare the environment for Behat tests
scripts-descriptions.test: Run all tests for the WPCOM Legacy Redirector plugin
scripts-descriptions.test-integration: Run integration tests for the WPCOM Legacy Redirector plugin
scripts-descriptions.test-integration-ms: Run integration tests for the WPCOM Legacy Redirector plugin in multisite mode
scripts-descriptions.test-unit: Run unit tests for the WPCOM Legacy Redirector plugin
scripts-descriptions.test-unit-ms: Run unit tests for the WPCOM Legacy Redirector plugin in multisite mode
